name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 57 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2025-06-05, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.94 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
